review.reviewer: Antigravity implementation owner (self-review against live agy CLI bytes and hooks.md contract)
review.decision: Proceed with Tier 2+ Antigravity CLI (agy) integration across registry, hooks, transcript, usage, profile, doctor, UI fallbacks, and docs
review.notes: Verified live agy binary, hooks.json schema (~/.gemini/config/hooks.json named hook object, flat vs grouped PostToolUse, required JSON stdout, synchronous hook detach), and real transcript.jsonl bytes (USER_EXPLICIT/USER_INPUT with <USER_REQUEST>, MODEL/PLANNER_RESPONSE with model/input_tokens/cache_read_tokens/output_tokens/tool_calls/content, SYSTEM/ERROR_MESSAGE). Deliberately excludes PreToolUse because agy requires an allow/deny/ask permission verdict.

evidence_limits: Contract and fixture tests verify observed live transcript.jsonl bytes, hook payloads, JSON stdout, installer/doctor round-trips, and usage accounting without launching a live paid model turn.

cases.description: Registry declares agy manifest with aliases, radar detection, resume argv, resource attribution, hook display, content parser, and dedicated semantics
cases.setup: Canonical internal/agents registry and golden accessor tests.
cases.action: Inspect HookEquippedKeys, Profiles, DisplayNames, ResumeArgv, ResourceNames, ContentKeys, DedicatedSemanticsKeys, CommandKeys, and For aliases.
cases.expected: agy appears in all Tier 2 projections, resolves antigravity and antigravity-cli aliases, and maps agy binary to canonical key agy.

cases.description: agy hooks installer writes, verifies, repairs, preserves foreign hooks and disabled policy, and cleanly uninstalls named gtmux entry in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json
cases.setup: Isolated HOME with foreign named hooks, disabled gtmux hook policy, corrupted/incomplete bindings, and executable hook fixture.
cases.action: Run updateAgentSettings install/reinstall/uninstall, missingAgentHookEvents, hookPolicyDisabled, and doctor rowAgentHook for agy.
cases.expected: Named gtmux hook writes flat SessionStart/PreInvocation/Stop and grouped PostToolUse with matcher *, omits PreToolUse, preserves foreign hooks, respects enabled:false, detects missing/wrong bindings, and cleanly removes only gtmux on uninstall.

cases.description: agy hook runtime classifies lifecycle events, distinguishes PreInvocation turn start vs continuation, maps Stop terminationReason, extracts camelCase fields, detaches sync work, and emits contract JSON stdout
cases.setup: Isolated HOME/state dir with synthetic camelCase agy hook payloads piped to hook.Run.
cases.action: Classify and run SessionStart, PreInvocation (invocationNum 1 and 3), PostToolUse, and Stop (NO_TOOL_CALL, USER_CANCELED, ERROR, MAX_INVOCATIONS).
cases.expected: PreInvocation 1 opens turn with cleaned lastUserInput; PreInvocation >1 resolves as Resumed; Stop maps USER_CANCELED to Interrupt and ERROR/MAX_INVOCATIONS to StopFailure; non-detached invocations emit valid JSON stdout ({} or {"decision":"stop"}).
surfaces: Hook runtime / Radar state / Event journal

cases.description: agy transcript parser reads real-shape transcript.jsonl turns, tool calls, timestamps, error status, and rejects path traversal
cases.setup: Isolated AGY_HOME with sanitized real-shape fixture testdata/agy-current.jsonl plus error-ending and invalid-id fixtures.
cases.action: Call Load, FirstMessageTime, LastMessageTime, LastMessageError, AgentForSession, and LogPath for agy.
cases.expected: Extracts clean user request text without metadata tags, ignores SYSTEM_MESSAGE and errored PLANNER_RESPONSE partial text, parses tool_calls into inspectable steps, reads RFC3339 created_at timestamps, reports terminal ERROR_MESSAGE, and rejects unsafe session IDs.
surfaces: Chat / Trace / Digest / HQ session age

cases.description: Usage accounting parses agy PLANNER_RESPONSE delta token records and computes live context footprint and cumulative burn
cases.setup: Isolated AGY_HOME with multi-turn agy transcript.jsonl carrying input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, output_tokens, model, and created_at.
cases.action: Run parseLine and ForSession for agy.
cases.expected: Accumulates non-cached input and output deltas across turns and reports last turn input_tokens + cache_read_tokens as CtxTok.
surfaces: Usage CLI / API / HQ self-rotate ctx

cases.description: Agent profile observer extracts agy model facts from hook modelName and transcript PLANNER_RESPONSE model records
cases.setup: Synthetic agy hook payload with modelName and transcript line with model.
cases.action: Invoke HookFacts and log decode for agy.
cases.expected: Records model fact from both native hook and session log without retaining prompts or unrelated fields.

cases.description: Knowledge distribution includes agy global instruction carrier (~/.gemini/config/GEMINI.md / $AGY_CONFIG_DIR) across carrier resolution and serialized sync
cases.setup: Isolated HQ home with AGY_CONFIG_DIR cleared alongside other carrier env overrides.
cases.action: Run Carriers, SyncMachine, storage-boundary sync, and serialized sync tests.
cases.expected: agy carrier resolves to $HOME/.gemini/config/GEMINI.md, receives the managed machine knowledge block, stays idempotent on resync, and participates in serialized sync without lock leaks.

cases.description: HQ transcript miner extracts human correction leads from agy transcript.jsonl while ignoring compaction summaries, system reminders, and errored planner drafts
cases.setup: Isolated agy brain directory with synthetic transcript.jsonl containing CONTEXT_SUMMARY, USER_REQUEST, SYSTEM_MESSAGE, errored PLANNER_RESPONSE, completed reply, and follow-up correction.
cases.action: Run mine.Run against the agy root.
cases.expected: Emits one correction candidate attributed to agent agy and conversation ID with context from the completed reply, excluding compaction summaries, system messages, and errored drafts.
